rationale: The papers 'Detecting and Classifying Flares in High-Resolution Solar Spectra with Supervised Machine Learning' (2406.15594), 'A Machine-Learning Approach for Identifying CME-Associated Stellar Flares in TESS Observations' (2512.15484), and 'Scalable, Advanced Machine Learning-based Approaches for Stellar Flare Identification' (2409.02540) directly investigate the detection and classification of stellar flares using machine learning techniques, contributing evidence relevant to the question.
